answer: Sybil resistance binds each identity to bonded collateral, so coordinated equivocation by k identities incurs a correlated penalty proportional to O(k^2), rather than k independent linear fines. Detection additionally applies an exponential multiplier to capital loss across the controlling stake, making larger swarms economically self-defeating: the reef exposes the ledge of shared control, while every glacier of recycled collateral remains slashable within the escrow set.
